body_markdown:
On Wednesday, October 28, we’ll launch an updated Online Banking platform and new Bank7 Mobile Banking app designed to make managing your accounts easier, more convenient, and more consistent across devices.


The upgrade will bring Personal and Business Online Banking together in one streamlined experience, along with an updated mobile app and enhanced tools for managing your accounts on the go.


**What You Need to Know:**


As we get closer to October 28, we’ll continue sharing important updates about the transition here (link to landing page), including:


- Key dates and upgrade timelines
- Steps you need to take before launch
- Information about logging in for the first time
- Helpful resources and click-through demos of the new experience


**Stay Up to Date:**


We’ve created a dedicated Digital Banking Upgrade page where you can find the latest information, resources and updates as we prepare for launch.


Visit[bank7.com/upgrade](http://bank7.com/upgrade) to learn more.


We look forward to bringing you an improved digital banking experience and will continue to keep you informed every step of the way.
